The '''Scarab Dais''' is where the [[Scarab Gong]] is located, just northwest of the [[Scarab Wall]] outside of [[Ahn'Qiraj: The Fallen Kingdom|Ahn'Qiraj]], in southern [[Silithus]].

The quests to start the [[10 Hour War]] during the [[War Effort]] to open the [[Gates of Ahn'Qiraj]] took place here.
